oracles.claim: Two real role key generations and derivations shall succeed, return the role ABI lengths, and produce the same native shared value: fp2toos(isoex2(pkB,skA)) == fp2toos(isoex3(pkA,skB)) at length 2*Np; the derandomization hook shall accept scalar 0, 1 and the largest legal scalar as positive controls.
oracles.source_reference: SIKE spec §1.3.6-1.3.9 PDF pp.18-21 and §1.3.10 PDF pp.21-22; plans/specs/sike-SIDH-spec.pdf sha256 9638f49b
limitations: SIDH is not authenticated and provides no contributory behaviour, forward secrecy or CCA protection
The native shared value is the 2*Np-byte j-invariant encoding, never a SIKE KDF secret
SIKE and SIDH shared values are not interchangeable

controls.positive_control: both roles derive the same 2*Np-byte shared value
controls.negative_control: the SIKE ss_len is never used as the expected SIDH length

oracles.claim: When a compatible independent reference or optimized build of the same parameter set is supplied, Alice's scalar and public key computed by either build shall agree and both role orders shall recover the same shared value; the normal and optimized strategies shall produce identical j-invariants after normalization.
oracles.source_reference: SIKE spec §1.3.8 PDF pp.19-20 and Appendices A/B §2.1-2.2; plans/specs/sike-SIDH-spec.pdf sha256 9638f49b
limitations: Only the pinned generic source is vendored, so the lane degrades to a same-source single-implementation check and must be reported as such
Textbook Weierstrass examples from the specification are not a byte-compatible pair
Projective coordinates are compared only after normalization to a mathematical invariant

controls.positive_control: both builds and both role orders recover the same shared value
controls.negative_control: the pair declares peer key exchange and a compatible reference before enabling

oracles.claim: The independent model shall classify public-key coordinates against the canonical field range (p-1 accepted, p and above rejected) and a cfpk fixture with x=0 shall be classified as FAIL; degenerate curves (A^2=4), repeated points and low-order points are treated as a robustness set whose behaviour is recorded, without inventing a complete public-key validation promise for the target.
oracles.source_reference: SIKE spec §1.2.1 PDF pp.11-12 and §1.1.4; plans/specs/sike-SIDH-spec.pdf sha256 9638f49b
limitations: Range-valid is not the same as a valid basis or a valid curve
The target API does not promise full subgroup or supersingularity validation; target-side behaviour is a separate API observation

claim_variants.claim: The model cfpk/coordinate checks classify canonical boundaries and a zero x-coordinate exactly as the pinned reference helper does.
claim_variants.source_reference: SIKE spec §1.2.1 and Appendix A/B; plans/specs/sike-SIDH-spec.pdf sha256 9638f49b
limitations: The hook is a test-only build of the pinned helper, not a public API

controls.positive_control: p-1 and a valid basis are classified as accepted
controls.negative_control: p, p+1 and x=0 are classified as rejected

claim_variants.claim: Degenerate or malformed peer keys passed through the external KEX API are recorded as observations (status, output length, shared value), because the API does not declare full public-key validation.
claim_variants.source_reference: NIST API contract; pinned PQCrypto-SIDH implementation; plans/specs/sike-SIDH-spec.pdf sha256 9638f49b
limitations: No rejection contract is assumed; acceptance of a malformed peer key is reported, not treated as a specification violation

controls.positive_control: the honest peer key produces the expected shared value
controls.negative_control: each malformed peer key is a real byte-level change recorded in the trace

controls.positive_control: canonical coordinates and an honest public key are accepted
controls.negative_control: out-of-range, zero and degenerate candidates are classified by the independent model before any target verdict

oracles.claim: The model shall check role-specific scalar spaces: skA in [0,2^e2) with Nsk2 bytes and skB in [0,2^floor(log2(3^e3))) with Nsk3 bytes, the public keys use the complementary torsion basis, and a typed wrapper shall reject passing skA where skB or a peer key role is expected.
oracles.source_reference: SIKE spec §1.3.3 and §1.3.9 PDF pp.18-21; plans/specs/sike-SIDH-spec.pdf sha256 9638f49b
limitations: Role separation in a C wrapper is a harness contract, not a high-level authentication guarantee
Scalar range validity is not a security result against the 2022 attacks

controls.positive_control: the minimum, maximum and honestly generated scalars for each role are classified as in range
controls.negative_control: an out-of-range or role-swapped scalar is classified as misrouted or out of range

oracles.claim: The independent integer model shall agree with the pinned reference on Fp2 multiplication and inversion, cfpk from a public basis, and the j-invariant, including j(A=6) = 287496 mod p; after an isogeny the basis order and normalized mathematical quantities shall agree with the reference computation.
oracles.source_reference: SIKE spec §1.1 PDF pp.8-11 and Appendices A/B; plans/specs/sike-SIDH-spec.pdf sha256 9638f49b
limitations: The expensive full isogeny reference is the pinned generic implementation; the Python model provides an independent cross-check of the intermediate layers only
Projective coordinates are compared only through normalized invariants

controls.positive_control: the model reproduces the pinned reference on fixed field, cfpk and j-invariant fixtures
controls.negative_control: a perturbed A or coordinate changes the normalized j-invariant

oracles.claim: Each role's key generation shall consume its own tape, a failure shall be observable rather than silently replaced, the declared output length shall always be fully written on success (no 0xA5 sentinel), and anomalous peer keys shall execute in the isolated worker without inventing a rejection contract.
oracles.source_reference: SIKE spec §1.3 PDF pp.18-20; harness common contract §1.4.4-1.4.6; plans/specs/sike-SIDH-spec.pdf sha256 9638f49b
limitations: The API does not declare a rejection of anomalous peer keys, so only safe execution and the declared output shape are checked
Same-tape equality is a same-build property
Timing conclusions are excluded from this oracle

claim_variants.claim: Key generation consumes the documented tape and reproduces the same public key for the same scalar and tape; the shared output length is exactly 2*Np.
limitations: Reproducibility is a same-build property

controls.positive_control: the same tape and scalar reproduce the same public key
controls.negative_control: a different tape or scalar changes the public key

claim_variants.claim: A failure-mode tape is observed by the harness control and does not silently fall back to system entropy; no sentinel bytes remain in a successful output.
limitations: The allowed failure output state is profile-specific; "must zero" is not assumed

controls.positive_control: the honest path returns the full shared length
controls.negative_control: the failure-mode tape is observed as consumed

controls.positive_control: the honest keygen/derive paths return the full declared lengths
controls.negative_control: failure-mode tapes are observed and anomalous inputs are a recorded byte-level change

oracles.claim: The opt-in timing lane shall compare SIKE correct versus fallback path and SIDH scalar classes in a dedicated non-sanitized binary with CPU control, warmup and multiple-comparison correction; the generic variable-time reference is never used to claim that an optimized target is unsafe.
oracles.source_reference: SIKE spec §2.1-2.2 and §5.3; harness common §1.4 timing policy; plans/specs/sike-SIDH-spec.pdf sha256 9638f49b
limitations: Opt-in P2 lane; not part of the default smoke contract
Sanitized default binaries never produce a timing conclusion
Only candidate evidence is produced; the measured object is labelled explicitly

controls.positive_control: the valid class is measured in the same harness
controls.negative_control: the lane reports not_applicable when the timing binary or capability is absent
